model_configuration.selection: minimum finite parity-1 masked MSE on the same pre-breach scenes
model_configuration.spatial_support: 16-pixel checkerboard parity-0 fit; parity-1 same-scene development monitor
model_configuration.stopping: eligible development nonimprovements only after minimum epoch; no convergence guarantee
model_configuration.target: mean of valid source pixels per channel and quadrant; four target-quadrant folds

calibration.reason: No independent threshold-calibration role was admitted; the manifest has no closed opportunity schedule, reviewed stationarity/declustering, or verified independent support count

geometry.note: PI-specified exact affine retained. Its pixel-area center differs slightly from the rounded NRSC coordinate; no exact centering or full-lake coverage claim.

interpretation: Each model was actually retrained with its declared channel representation; same architecture, seeds, budget and selection rule.
Primary raw-band components use the primary model predictions; companion raw-band residuals come from separate reflectance-only fits.
All residuals use pre-period standardized channels; compare shared raw-band components for a common target, not differently scaled objectives as independent performance metrics.
Seven-channel model architecture retained; index inputs/presence and targets are excluded in the companion. Unused index standardizer entries do not enter its tokens or objective.
No clamping, fabricated inputs, causal attribution, independent event replication or operational warning inference.

scientific_limits: Two developmental ROIs, same-scene spatial monitoring
All preperiod parameter fitting is development-exposed
Single September SAR acquisition, no SAR change sequence
Candidate query mask, no independently validated lake boundary
No event/control labels, calibrated annual exposure, lead-time or detection-performance claim
Attention is internal distribution, not causal explanation
